claims.statement: None of the six Gemini item IDs exists in the current repository.
Closest numeric production IDs do not match the reviewed content: EQ08V1_045 is a product equation, SYS09V1_012 checks a linear equation in two variables, and FUN10V1_022 is a value-table item.
Actual written items 08-WR-10, 09-WR-05 and 10-WR-08 have different prompts from Gemini's descriptions.
Independent source QA discovered corrupted LaTeX escaping in CĐ08-CĐ10 Practice Room Markdown. This is a real production defect unrelated to Gemini's six corrections.

decisions: Reject all six Gemini corrections as ungrounded against current production source.
Fix the verified Markdown LaTeX escaping defect in CĐ08-CĐ10.
Add CI checks for control characters and common unescaped TeX tokens in Practice Room Markdown.
Any future Gemini review must quote the exact repository item ID and current prompt text before proposing a correction.

acceptance.notes: Gemini review not integrated due source mismatch. Verified Markdown rendering defect fixed independently.
